why: STAYS (the largest body, left unlinked per C-002's F not-a-run): G1-G8, the 1,727 fan-made Judge Dredd story extracts cut out of 2000 AD progs in the eight 'Judge Dredd Part 01..08' folders - every one of them is named '2000AD #<prog> Judge Dredd - <story>' (checked: no other filename shape in G1-G8), including the '(Colour Reprint)' twins, the lettered annual/special/Megazine extras (#114b, #175f Max Normal, #1819b JDMeg. #333) and the long-story compilations (Judge Child 153pp, Cursed Earth 165pp); they are not a published run and are not joined to S37 2000 AD. MOVES, the four published comics (20 files): (1) G13 + G15 (9 files, 106359-106365 and 106377/106378) = IDW's Judge Dredd collected Vol. 01-07 (per-file CV 34817 / GCD 73628 on all nine), the trades of IDW's 2012 ongoing CV 54111 / GCD 70025 (30 issues) -> JOIN S94777 under its key 'Judge Dredd v1 (2013)': --who-stores cv=54111 shows S94777 is the only shelf storing that run (S line B-037 0.95 cv=54111 gcd=70025), and it already holds another rip of the SAME seven books (30896-30902, Minutemen-Thoth Vol. 01-07, 99-146pp against our 100-146pp, same per-file 34817x7 / 73628x7) plus v05 106379 - our two v03/v04 DR & Quinch files are further duplicate rips of Vol. 03/04; (2) G9 + G12 + G14 (4482, 30893, 106380) = three rips of the Judge Dredd: Year One TPB (per-file CV 68529 / GCD 223522, 104-105pp) collecting IDW's four-issue mini CV 59192 / GCD 72940 (2013) - the run wins, new key; no shelf stores 59192/72940/68529/223522 (--who-stores: 0 S lines); (3) G10 (4486-4492) = Rebellion's Essential Judge Dredd Vol. 01-07 (2020-2023, 160-228pp), a volume line reprinting many separate 2000 AD / Megazine stories - a line spanning several runs is its own identity; ComicVine mints a volume per book (129860/133318/138336/143600/144275/152641/159731) and GCD holds only 181497 (Vol. 01) and 223094 (Tour of Duty), so no spanning record: new key, run omitted; the per-file gcd 138393 on 4487 (Delirium 'Judge Dredd' 2016, S94778's stamp) is wrong and is not carried; (4) G11 30894 = the one-shot Judge Dredd: 100-Page Giant (IDW 2020, CV 125630 / GCD 157474, count 1 each, our rip 100pp) - its OWN name. NEARBY, not joined: S37 (2000 AD weekly - the extracts are not issues of it); S102397 'Judge Dredd v1 (1983)' (Eagle US reprint), S102398 'v2 (1986)' (Quality), S94778 'v2 (2016)' (Delirium) - different publishers/decades, none holds any book moved here; S10038 Megazine, S10031 Trifecta, S10003 America, S10008 Deviations, S10011 Mandroid, S10012 Mechanismo, S10017 Origins, S10041 Toxic are separate single books/runs whose records (cv 22821/66347/51358/100062/48510/48624/19993/114649) none of our moved files carry - Essential Vol. 01 America and Vol. 03 Origins are Rebellion's 2020s Essential editions (CV 129860/138336), not the older America (51358) or Origins (19993) books those shelves hold
